work.status.label: state of this machine
work.status.driverTip: whether this machine is watching for work to start. Opens its settings.
work.status.sessionsTip: how many sessions are active here: running, or waiting on you. Opens Sessions.
work.status.workspaceTip: the workspace you are looking at. Everything on screen is scoped to it.
work.status.remoteTip: whether this workspace has a deployment to share with. Opens its wiring.
work.status.indexedTip: what the index holds for this scope. Opens the repositories it came from.
work.status.setupTip: how many of the steps this machine needs are done. Opens Setup.
